host.placement: primary, standby and client on one host; no CPU pinning; not isolated from other host activity

compare-screen-ssd.primary_config:
max_connections = 100			# (change requires restart)
shared_buffers = 128MB			# min 128kB
dynamic_shared_memory_type = posix	# the default is usually the first option
max_wal_size = 1GB
min_wal_size = 80MB
log_timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
autovacuum_worker_slots = 16		# autovacuum worker slots to allocate
datestyle = 'iso, mdy'
timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
lc_messages = C				# locale for system error message
lc_monetary = C				# locale for monetary formatting
lc_numeric = C				# locale for number formatting
lc_time = C				# locale for time formatting
default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.english'
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
port = 56532
unix_socket_directories = '/home/reshke/pgpg2/compare-screen-ssd/data'
max_connections = 286
shared_buffers = '256MB'
max_wal_senders = 4
wal_level = replica
wal_buffers = '64MB'
max_wal_size = '512MB'
min_wal_size = '80MB'
checkpoint_timeout = '30min'
autovacuum = off
fsync = on
full_page_writes = on
synchronous_standby_names = 'bench_standby'

failed_attempts.reason: pgbench timed out after streaming standby requested WAL that had already been removed. No persistent physical replication slot was configured. No latency row included. Feature variant was not started. Retried both variants with a slot in compare-message32k-tls-slot.

notes: All successful comparison rows are included, including regressions and queue stalls.
The filename screen-ssd is historical: actual disk medium was not established. It means persistent block storage.
Eight initial disk-screen CPU snapshots flagged an ephemeral monitoring connection; do not use those CPU totals for conclusions. Later runs exclude the monitor.
Quantiles are per measurement window. Summaries use medians across runs, not pooled transaction quantiles.
Original per-transaction gzip logs, stdout, server logs and full metadata remain in /home/reshke/pgpg2/<dataset>/ on the benchmark host.
